race.comment: AVENUE MONTAIGNE (7) is a very consistent conveyance who is yet to miss the top-four in nine starts to date and this is not an overly strong affair. Ready to peak now third run back from the spell and should be right there when the whips are cracking. MINNIE VEGAS (9) broke the maiden status two back before just missing the frame at Townsville last time out. Has to be included in calculations. MUSKITO (3) boasts a win over this distance range and strips fitter third-up from the break. In the mix. GOLDEN GLAZE (12) has a win over this course and distance and gets in light with the claim. May earn some minor money. YOUMEANDDUPRE (6) next best from the favourable draw.
